title: desktop.look input
description: What to show of the selected declared desktop.

device.description: Desktop friendly name; omitted uses the declared local conversation desktop.

shot.description: What to screenshot after: the focused monitor (default; or output), every monitor, a window, a zoom into your last screenshot, or none.

output.description: Monitor for shot=screen, e.g. DP-3 or HDMI-A-1.

zoom.description: For shot=zoom: a rectangle in your last screenshot's pixels.

layout.description: Also list monitors, workspaces and windows.
